video.title: AI欧腐《黑帮教父的专属画师：为我上色/Claimed by the Mafia: Color Me Yours, My Don》
video.desc:
flickreels最近喜欢搞未完结啊
Elias, a brilliant erotic artist, vows to stop painting such works. But when Cesare, a mafia don, discovers one of Elias's pieces, it becomes the only thing that calms his madness and lets him sleep. Cesare forces Elias to his estate and binds him to a contract: paint one erotic scene every night. Elias agrees, but only because his gravely ill sister needs a fortune for her treatment. Trapped between his sister's life and his own dignity, Elias enters the don's dark world, where desire and danger coil around every brushstroke.
Elias 是一位才华横溢的情色画家，却早已发誓不再画这类作品。可当黑帮教父 Cesare 偶然得到他的一幅画，这幅画便成了唯一能平息他的疯狂、让他安然入睡的东西。
Cesare 将 Elias 强行带回自己的庄园，用一纸合同将他束缚：每晚画一幅情色画。Elias 答应了——只因病重的妹妹需要一大笔治疗费用。
困在妹妹的性命与自己的尊严之间，Elias 踏入了教父的黑暗世界。在那里，欲望与危险缠绕着每一笔、每一划。
